notes.title: Monthly Changelog - June 2021
notes.content:
Hai Epifrogians!

It's probably the biggest changelog in our history! 
It's probably the last changelog before the official demo release!
Looks what's new in Epifrog swampy world.

🐸 🐸 🐸

NEW: Tadpole grow mechanic has been added.
NEW: From now on, the Magic Pond Statue is able to take damage.
NEW: Build&rebuild mechanic is ready.
NEW: The Hero (Epifrog) can use Super Defence&Super Run commands.
NEW: Frogs can defend the gate while U'mans are forcing it.
NEW: Carnivore plants&sticky bubbles has been successfully added and implemented.
NEW: No action mechanic when mini-game failed.
NEW: Creating a Mockup Interface Magic Pond Statue
NEW: Special terrain modules for beta gameplay has been added.
NEW: Created the Interface Weaponry Mockup
NEW: A visual representation of frogs throwing craft items - particle system
NEW: Tadpole spawn mechanics has been implemented.
NEW: The HUD has been added as well.
NEW: Creation of Places and Their Representation for Alternate Buildings.
NEW: Creating Icon Atlas for building interfaces.
NEW: Implementation of Interface Statue Magic Pond Sacrifice.
NEW: Animations with shader and material for Small Tadpole and BigTadpole has been added to game.
NEW: Created Toggle Mode.

🐸 🐸 🐸

NEW: Frog behavior added so now they attack U’mans when on their way back to the village
NEW: Frog Hunger Mechanic and Frog’s behavior while dying have been updated
NEW: Tutorial mechanic has been created and implemented
NEW: Game Over Screen has been implemented
NEW: Watchtower and U’mans Stone prefabs have been added
NEW: Sacrifice mechanic for Magic Pond Statue has been created & implemented
NEW: Spears have been added as a raw material to the storage
NEW: Hunger mechanic has been implemented
NEW: Each unit from now on has different sound while walking
NEW: Creation of a texture detection system under the units to generate appropriate sounds
NEW: Building’s HUD has been implemented
NEW: Mockup AlternateBuilding Inspector Ui has been created

🐸 🐸 🐸

NEW: U’man behaviour during Frog Village attack has been implemented
NEW: Ui & pike crafting from now on available in Weaponry
NEW: Menu scale adjustment
NEW: Day&Night sounds adjustment
NEW: Gate and traps opening with a kick has been implemented
NEW: Material sound has been added
NEW: Units sounds - receiving damage have been added
NEW: Units sounds - dealing damage have been added
NEW: Ambient Sounds have been added
NEW: Graphic representations of constructed buildings - an icon - were created

🐸 🐸 🐸

FIX: Throwing frogs out of the party when giving the order.
FIX: Turning on and off health bars and the problem of equipment.
FIX: Uman’s sometimes stay on spawn.
FIX: The frog returning to the village does not react.
FIX: Errors after restarting the game.
FIX: Graphic error of the Party aura at frogs.
FIX: Uman Brutes attack but do no Damage.
FIX: Errors at main menu.
FIX: Pop-up menu graphical error.
FIX: Frogs' inventory slots stack.

& tons of bugs have been fixed

notes.title: Monthly Changelog - May 2021
notes.content:
Hai Epifrogians!

It's time to share with you what was happening in the development of Epifrog last month. I have some pretty exciting news to share, so jump in to the swim and dive deep into our changelog.


:frog: :frog: :frog:


 Epifrog can use some new standard commands: "Run", "Defend", "Invite All" and "Disband All"
 ... and some super commands: "super attack", "super order to me" and "super kick"
 A package of new action icons appeared in the game 
 Gate and Alternate Buildings camera settings have been successfully implemented 
 Implemented a mini-game - you can activate it by holding down the action key
 New crafting icons has been added to the game
 From now on, the frog barricade can be activated when enemies are close to the village
 The terrain generation system for all tiers has been added to the game
 Some critical bugs fixed

notes.title: Changelog #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36566545/a213d376d2cdad93dbb62d7ba1dff3c41182dc14.jpg

Hi! Here is the list of recent changes: 

#12.05
-FIX: Updated icons in the frog tower.
-FIX: The marking of the currently used frog in the tower has been corrected (previously it was overwritten with random frogs from the party).

#14.05
-NEW: Now, the frogs who have the order to enter to the tower must approach to the entrance instead of teleporting from the starting point.

#29.05
-NEW: Units that don't use mana for casting spells or active skills, have their mana bars removed from the game.

#03.07
-NEW: A new unit has been added to enemie's wave spawn: Brute.

#04.07 
-FIX: Object pool has been added to game. This known mechanism solves a issue with performance in the game.
-NEW: The Hero(Epifrog) has a new dash skill. Dash was replaced with a jump skill.
-NEW: A night counter appeared in the game. Located in the main menu during the game.
-NEW: An extensive system has been introduced that allows easily developers to configure drop chances and drop ratio.
-NEW: Dev console tool has been added to game project. At the moment it's the basic version, where 90% of commands works.
